Name: Shane and Alex
Author: Quirinea
Description:
Alex and Shane are both interested in gridball. Why not bring them together? After JojaMart is out of business, Shane has less to do. And it turns out he's been a gridball coach earlier...

This small mod adds an event where it turns out that Alex needs some counselling for his sports practice, the player and Shane happen to be at place.

Adds also lines for Alex and Shane, some comments by Evelyn and George, too. And Alex sends you a snack recipe (you may laugh at my icon for it...).

I've also replaced a line where Alex tells he's thrown out a pair of shoes because of a smudge with one where he instead complains about the smudge. It did not seem to fit, as the family cannot be rich (what is their income? George probably has an invalid pension from miner's job, Evelyn's a part-time town garderer and Alex sells ice cream in the summer),  and also makes Alex an odd kind of jerk.

Requires SMAPI, Content patcher, Json assets and Mail Farmework

The mod  is in English  (as default) and Finnish (meant to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3974]Stardew Finnish[/url]).
